description:
Read one node of the open scene: every editable property with its value and type, or only the fields you name (transform, global_transform, scene_file_path, aabb). Next: summer_set_prop.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/inspect-node"}

fields.description: Only these fields: property names or globs (e.g. 'position', 'surface_material_override/*') and the derived fields transform, global_transform, scene_file_path, aabb, warnings.

maxCharacters.description: Most characters of text to return (default 4000). A longer result is cut and says so.

path.description: Node path from scene tree, e.g. 'Player', 'World/Enemies/Boss', 'DirectionalLight3D'

name: summer_inspect_node
title: Read a node's properties
